detail.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && (nohup npx vite --port 5179 --strictPort > /tmp/cornel-vite.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/cornel-vite.pid); sleep 6; echo '--- server log ---'; cat /tmp/cornel-vite.log; echo '--- HTTP checks ---'; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'index %{http_code}\n' 'http://localhost:5179/?debug=1&course=volcano&hole=4'; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'main.ts %{http_code}\n' 'http://localhost:5179/src/main.ts'; open -a "Google Chrome" 'http://localhost:5179/?debug=1&course=volcano&hole=4'; sleep 3; open -a "Google Chrome" 'http://localhost:5179/?debug=1&course=arctic-base&hole=4'; echo 'opened both URLs; vite pid' $(cat /tmp/cornel-vite.pid)
